item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Was waiting for one innings, right time has come”- Tilak Varma on change in his batting position
item.description: Tilak Varma was under pressure to score big after his below-par batting outcomes for India in the ongoing T20 World Cup 2026 tournament. Varma had returned to the Indian team after missing the New Zealand T20I series due to an injury. Batting at no. 3, Tilak found it hard to get the momentum and timing right and struggled to score well. There were even calls for his exclusion from the Indian team, as the Men in Blue stared at a group stage exit from the T20 World Cup ahead of the Zimbabwe game.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: ‘Not comparing myself with Babar Azam’- Umar Akmal clarifies after controversy on his X post
item.description: Former Pakistan cricketer Umar Akmal has cleared up his side after controversy happened over his post on X comparing his scores with Babar Azam's knocks in Pakistan’s performances inthe T20 World Cups. Akmal shared a collage illustrating Pakistan's two different innings and how many runs he scored in those matches. The first included his personal performance against Australia in the 2014 T20 World Cup, in which he hit 94 off 54 balls to help Pakistan rebound from 25-2 to 191-5 and win by 16 runs

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- Hardik and Dube do bowling practice after win v Zimbabwe; Gavaskar in awe of their dedication
item.description: India all-rounders Hardik Pandya and Shivam Dube showed that there are no days off in an ICC event as they began their bowling practice right after India defeated Zimbabwe in Chennai in the T20 World Cup 2026 on February 26. Sunil Gavaskar and Varun Aaron praised both all-rounders' attitudes, saying they were pleased to see their determination to improve ahead of the key match against the West Indies. item.title: IPL 2026 start date changed; likely to begin on March 28, with final on May 31- Report
item.description: The IPL 2026’s start date has reportedly been changed. Earlier, the IPL management had informed the franchises on December 15, 2025, that the 19th edition of the tournament would begin on March 26. However, now ESPNCricinfo has reported that the IPL has internally decided to change the start date to March 28, and has the final on May 31. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- “You are in a family”- Abhishek reveals Gambhir, Surya told him he'd play all games
item.description: India batter Abhishek Sharma finally found form as he smashed 55 runs in the recent T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8s game against Zimbabwe on February 26 in Chennai. This knock came after three ducks and a 15-run knock against South Africa in India’s big 76-run loss. However, against Zimbabwe, Abhishek showed great composure, taking his time with the bat and scoring 55 off just 30 deliveries, peppering the boundary with four sixes and four fours. item.title: WATCH- Rinku Singh bids emotional farewell to his father; carries his body to performs last rites
item.description: Indian cricket star Rinku Singh suffered a huge personal loss as his father, Khanchand Singh, lost his battle with cancer and breathed his last on Friday morning at the Yatharth Hospital in Greater Noida. He was being treated for fourth-stage liver cancer but passed away on February 27. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “There'll be some nerves,” admits Mitchell Santner as New Zealand’s semifinal hopes rely on Pakistan
item.description: Already qualified for semifinals, England defeated New Zealand by four wickets in Colombo on Friday (February 27) to top Super 8s Group 2 of T20 World Cup 2026. Chasing 160, Will Jacks' quickfire 32* off 18 balls saw England overcome a top-order collapse, overhauling the target with three balls to spare. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Did you see where Dube was bowling?” Kris Srikkanth raises concerns over India’s sixth bowler
item.description: Team India might have defeated Zimbabwe by 72 runs in their crucial T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 clash at Chepauk on Thursday (February 26), but Shivam Dube’s poor performance with the ball became a major talking point.
